emails:invoice-ready.title: Invoice Ready
emails:invoice-ready.description: A calm billing document with the amount, due date, invoice reference, billing period, and one route to the full invoice.

emails:payment-failed.title: Payment Failed
emails:payment-failed.description: A red action-required notice that names the failed charge, payment method, next retry, temporary account state, and one repair action.

emails:plan-changed.title: Plan Changed
emails:plan-changed.description: A factual plan confirmation that compares the previous and current plan, effective date, next charge, and billing destination.

emails:trial-ending.title: Trial Ending
emails:trial-ending.description: A yellow orientation message that states the exact trial end date, what happens next, and one deliberate plan choice without fake urgency.

emails:card-expiring.title: Card Expiring
emails:card-expiring.description: An early payment-method reminder that identifies the card, expiry, affected workspace, and next charge without presenting a failure that has not happened.

emails:refund-issued.title: Refund Issued
emails:refund-issued.description: A green proof-of-progress message with refund amount, destination, order reference, realistic arrival window, and one order route.
